text: In January 2023 an impact-investor consortium led by new shareholders Invest-NL and the ABN AMRO Sustainable Impact Fund and existing shareholder Quadia (Regenero Impact Fund), with existing shareholders DALHAP, DOEN Participaties and PDENH, invested €49 million in Fairphone; Invest-NL's part was €20 million in shares.
short: Fairphone's shareholders include Invest-NL, the ABN AMRO Sustainable Impact Fund, Quadia, DALHAP, DOEN Participaties and PDENH.

source.name: Stichting DOEN: Impact investor consortium invests €49 million in Fairphone
source.quote: led by new shareholders Invest-NL, the ABN AMRO Sustainable Impact Fund and existing shareholder Quadia with its Regenero Impact Fund, joined forces with other existing shareholders DALHAP, DOEN Participaties and PDENH

additionalSources.name: Invest-NL: Fairphone
additionalSources.quote: Invest-NL invests € 20 million in Fairphone, the Dutch sustainable smartphone company.
